SCOPE OF SERVICE The Contractor shall provide enterprise -grade mobile and data services to the U.S. Embassy Panama. The prices listed below shall include all labor, service, equipment, technical support, materials, insurance (see FAR 52.228 -4 and 52.228- 5), overhead, and profit. The Government will pay the Contractor on a monthly basis for routine services that have been satisfactorily performed. The Contractor shall ensure that all services are delivered with high availability, reliability, and performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. The Contractor shall offer two different plans to fulfill the Government needs: Basic Plan. Pay per use for actual calls (local, local long distance, international long distance), incoming and outgoing roaming calls, incoming and outgoing local SMS, incoming

cient to support Government communications during emergencies, major service disruptions, natural disasters, or periods of significant network congestion. The Contractor shall maintain a disaster recovery and service restoration plan designed to minimize service interruptions and restore affected services in a timely manner. Upon request by the Government, the Contractor shall provide a high- level overview of its recovery and continuity capabilities applicable to services provided. The Contractor shall identify emergency escalation procedures and points of contact for major outages affecting Government services. 14. QUALITY ASSURANCE AND SURVEILLANCE PLAN (QASP) a) This plan provides an effective method to promote satisfactory contractor performance. The Contractor, not the Government, is responsible for management and quality control to meet the terms of the contract.
